name: Lazy
source:
You are in love with someone else, everything is against you... Nothing let predict that this lazy guy would end one day in your bed. And yet...

[From [url=https://yumeromansu.itch.io/le-paresseux]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你爱上了别人，一切都与你作对……没有人能预测这个懒惰的家伙有一天会死在你的床上。然而……

[来自[url=https://yumeromansu.itch.io/le-paresseux]Itch.io[/url]]
